page.notes: Printed page number is 213 (rendered in old-style figures on the scan). Verse 49 "Danah" is printed with an accent over the first a; verse 50 "Esthemoh" and 58 "Beth-sur" read as printed; the scan is somewhat blurred in places, so individual letters in verses 50 and 59 are uncertain.
